name: inflectiv
description: MCP server for the Inflectiv AI platform — manage agents, datasets, files, and webhooks from Claude Desktop or Claude Code

api_key.title: Inflectiv API Key
api_key.description: API key scoped to a dataset (starts with inf_). Create one from any dataset page in the dashboard.

base_url.title: API Base URL
base_url.description: Override API URL (for self-hosted or local dev)

wallet_private_key.title: EVM Wallet Private Key (x402)
wallet_private_key.description: EVM wallet private key for x402 crypto payments. When set and credits are 0, pays per-request with USDC on Base.

tools.name: inflectiv_list_agents
tools.description: List all agents that have the API key's dataset attached. Free.

tools.name: inflectiv_create_agent
tools.description: Create a new AI agent. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: inflectiv_get_agent
tools.description: Get details of a specific agent. Free.

tools.name: inflectiv_update_agent_config
tools.description: Update an agent's configuration (personality, instructions, model, temperature). Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: inflectiv_chat_with_agent
tools.description: Send a message to an agent and get a RAG-enabled, multi-turn response. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: inflectiv_list_agent_datasets
tools.description: List all datasets attached to an agent. Free.

tools.name: inflectiv_attach_dataset
tools.description: Attach a dataset to an agent in read_only or self_learning mode. Free.

tools.name: inflectiv_update_dataset_mode
tools.description: Update the mode (read_only or self_learning) of a dataset attached to an agent. Free.

tools.name: inflectiv_list_datasets
tools.description: List datasets accessible via this API key. Free.

tools.name: inflectiv_create_dataset
tools.description: Create a new dataset. Requires a global API key.

tools.name: inflectiv_clone_dataset
tools.description: Clone an accessible dataset into the user's account. Requires a global API key.

tools.name: inflectiv_update_dataset
tools.description: Update dataset name, description, and/or instructions. Owner only. Free.

tools.name: inflectiv_reindex_dataset
tools.description: Reindex dataset vectors after bulk changes. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: inflectiv_search_dataset
tools.description: Semantic search across a dataset's knowledge base. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: inflectiv_batch_search
tools.description: Run up to 20 semantic searches against a single dataset. Costs 1 credit per query.

tools.name: inflectiv_cross_query
tools.description: Run one query against multiple accessible datasets. Requires a global API key + advanced tier. Costs 1 credit per dataset.

tools.name: inflectiv_write_intelligence
tools.description: Write a single intelligence entry to a dataset (auto-embedded, deduplicated). Costs 1 credit (0 if duplicate).

tools.name: inflectiv_batch_write_intelligence
tools.description: Write up to 50 intelligence entries to a dataset. Costs 1 credit per new entry; duplicates are free.

tools.name: inflectiv_list_intelligence
tools.description: List intelligence entries in a dataset with filtering and pagination. Free.

tools.name: inflectiv_list_files
tools.description: List files (knowledge sources) in a dataset. Free.

tools.name: inflectiv_get_file
tools.description: Get details and processing status of a specific file. Free.

tools.name: inflectiv_upload_file
tools.description: Upload a local file to a dataset as a knowledge source. Costs 5 credits base + 1/MB over 5MB.

tools.name: inflectiv_reprocess_file
tools.description: Reprocess a previously uploaded file after a processing failure. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: inflectiv_list_knowledge_sources
tools.description: List ALL knowledge sources in a dataset (files, URLs, manual text, AI-generated). Free.

tools.name: inflectiv_register_webhook
tools.description: Register an HTTPS webhook to receive event notifications. Max 10 per user. Free.

tools.name: inflectiv_list_webhooks
tools.description: List all registered webhooks. Free.

tools.name: inflectiv_test_webhook
tools.description: Send a test event to a registered webhook to verify it receives payloads. Free.
